environment.description: Same service deployed on ECS Fargate with a custom task definition. The container uses a bespoke AppArmor profile (arn:aws:ecs:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:apparmor-profile/workflow-orchestrator-v3.2) loaded via ECS agent configuration parameter 'appArmorProfile' in the container definition's linuxParameters.apparmorProfile field. The profile was generated using aa-logprof after a 30-day learning period and specifies explicit 'owner' file rules: '/var/lib/workflow/state/** rw' and '/var/log/workflow/** rw' with deny rules for all other write paths including 'deny /** w' as a catch-all and 'deny /etc/** rwlk' explicitly. The profile also includes 'deny /proc/** w' and 'deny /sys/** w'. Note: the profile uses 'file' abstraction but does NOT include the 'abstractions/nameservice' include, meaning DNS resolution still works via the allowed '/etc/resolv.conf r' rule. The profile is in enforce mode (not complain). Additionally, the Fargate task role has no S3 or SSM permissions, and the task runs as UID 1000 (non-root) with read-only root filesystem except for explicitly mounted tmpfs at /var/lib/workflow/state and /var/log/workflow.

config.network: NLB with gRPC health check on port 50051
